goal: Determine whether 32-example historical Brier deterioration is concentrated in recent archived training events or broadly present in chronologically distributed older learned events; decompose immediate context reset across the same windows
frozen_window_indices: For each original native ledger of length n, five disjoint blocks of 32 starting at floor(k*(n-32)/4), k=0,1,2,3,4; ledger order pinned in original archived training, last block matches published old probe

same-witness conventional native _append + _update_context with _load_context reset suppressed, disposable clone
unmodified native immediately after actual context reset
archived original exact final native checkpoint after 16 continuation events
metrics: native one-step historical 32-example Brier using original campaign native_old() on each of the five windows
original→final change per window; fraction of windows violating historical +0.03 Brier tolerance
same-update reset-only effect on same five windows
source/ledger prefix, exact original/final checkpoint hashes, published last32 Brier before/after reproduction to 1e-10
Ubuntu/Windows parity tolerance 1e-10 for all numeric historical scores
runtime CPU process seconds and zero fresh source actions
controls: original last32 published Brier exactly reproduced
identical sequential 16-event witness tape, original four-head model exact checkpoint at final
shadow clone makes same observed update but skips exactly the context reset; same episode receipt
all five blocks disjoint, fixed before scores
no new source, no model API, no source or run authority, no training phase labels to learner
no statistical inference from five non-independent windows; source families heterogeneous

precommitted_labels.BROAD_DIAGNOSTIC: At least 4 of 5 chronological old-probe blocks on BOTH seeds show original→final Brier increase >0.03; posthoc only, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS
precommitted_labels.LOCALIZED_OR_HETEROGENEOUS: BROAD_DIAGNOSTIC false, with all exact original/final reproduction controls passing; report exact spread, signs, sample-size caveats
precommitted_labels.REPRODUCTION_FAIL: Any incorrect frozen archived original/final checkpoint, original published last32 score mismatch >1e-10, mismatched archived episodes or reset ordinal, altered original source, or numeric Linux/Windows mismatch
